preamble: Vocalization of the rhotic [r] to the high front vowel [i]. In Middle Indo-Aryan the Sanskrit syllabic rhotic ṛ [r̩] often became the vowel i in Pali (ṛṣi > isi 'sage'), alongside outcomes a and u. Coda gliding of the Spanish tap to [j] (Cibaeño correi) is filed under ɾ → j.

examples.note: The syllabic rhotic ṛ became i; ṣ also became s.
ṛ > i after a palatal; ś also became s.
